question: Does a TorBox paid plan cap a single hoster (web) download at 100 GB, apart from the 200 GB per-torrent cap the records hold?
why: debridrank.com states 'Host downloads capped at 100 GB per transfer, paid plans only'; the torbox-essential, torbox-standard and torbox-pro records list 200 GB per download and per torrent and no separate hoster cap. Needs the vendor's account-restrictions page or a measured hoster download.
